create.name: Jamyang Buddhist Centre Leeds
create.bio:
Jamyang Buddhist Centre Leeds is a Tibetan Buddhist centre in Holbeck, Leeds, founded in 1996 and affiliated with the FPMT, the network begun by Lama Thubten Yeshe and Lama Zopa Rinpoche. Besides study and practice in the Mahayana tradition, it presents itself as a community wellbeing hub, with a vegetarian café, a shop with Dharma supplies and second-hand goods, a lending library and rooms that local groups can hire. In 2025 it welcomed its first resident teacher, Geshe Rinchen Wangyal, who trained at Drepung Losel Ling and the Institute of Buddhist Dialectics and later studied philosophy and religion at the University of Winchester.

Geshe Rinchen now teaches three weekly classes online: a drop-in Saturday morning session on core Buddhist ideas for newcomers, a Tuesday class on Madhyamaka texts for more experienced students, and the three-year Discovering Buddhism course on Thursdays. In the centre itself volunteers lead lunchtime meditations, pujas and secular wellbeing sessions, and Jamyang Leeds also hosts FPMT's In-Depth Meditation Training. A single monthly membership covers almost all of its classes, meditations and workshops.

courses.title: Saturday Mornings with Geshe Rinchen
courses.description: A weekly online drop-in class with the resident geshe, each week on a different basic Buddhist theme and how it applies to daily life, with time for questions. Aimed at beginners and those refreshing their understanding.

courses.title: Buddhism for Intermediate Students
courses.description: A Tuesday evening online class with Geshe Rinchen for students with some grounding, currently reading Tsongkhapa's commentary on the Middle Way and the philosophy of emptiness.

courses.title: Discovering Buddhism
courses.description: FPMT's three-year, fourteen-module course on the graduated path, taught online on Thursday evenings by Geshe Rinchen. Students can join at any point.

courses.title: Membership
courses.description: One monthly fee gives access to nearly the whole weekly programme, including weekend workshops; retreats, visiting teachers and the In-Depth Meditation Training are paid separately.
